cases.label: Jog / path target 1.2 m/s
cases.prompt: A person jogs forward slowly with relaxed rhythmic arm swings.

cases.label: Run / path target 3 m/s
cases.prompt: A person runs forward briskly with strong alternating strides and arm swings.

cases.label: Sprint / path target 5 m/s
cases.prompt: A person sprints forward quickly with long powerful strides and vigorous arm swings.

scope: Paired native Kimodo dense root-path constraints; no posthoc root stretching or playback speed changes. Targets are source SOMA-scale speeds. Actual hip/root speed and constraint errors must be measured.
